`write_executable` writes the script to a temporary name, closes it, sets mode 0755 and renames it into place. `output` and `run` retry up to 20 times with a 10 ms pause when starting a process fails with ETXTBSY. The crate docs explain the cause.

The moved call sites are `xtask/src/main.rs`, `crates/athena-cli/tests/reconcile.rs`, `crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs`, `crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs` and `crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs`. The crate is a workspace member and a dev-dependency of agent, core, cli and xtask. The `CHANGELOG.md` entry describes only this diff.

The crate has a stress test that writes and runs 200 scripts while 4 threads keep spawning processes. It passes, as do the 10 stand-in tests in `claude.rs`, fmt, and the policy scan. The whole workspace compiles, but I did not run the full test suite or clippy.

- **`snapshot.rs`:** `docs/decision-links.toml` lists it under decision D08. A change that touches it fails before the verifier unless the same change adds an entry to `docs/decisions.md` and a link, and both files are outside the allowed set. Its test only chmods a fixture file and never runs it, so it has no ETXTBSY risk.
- **`docs/architecture.md`:** I added a table row for the new crate, which the file list did not include. The policy test `dependency_direction_matches_the_architecture` fails without it.

The stress test's own scripts are not protected by the retry.
